decisions.reason: Reducing the initial package to one test video does not change the freelancer's full-service responsibility for footage, voiceover, and script.
The one-video evaluation changes deliverable quantity but does not alter the required opening-hook standard.
The source decision does not change the requirement to align the creative with the validated structure of the winning reference.
Beginning with one evaluation video does not alter the conversion-focused objective or the target CPL.
The deliverable-count reduction does not change the requirement for quicker, retention-focused cuts.
The landing-page and tracking audit was already deferred, and the decision to begin with one video neither resumes nor changes that separate work.
